title: 🤔 Teju points at the milk instead of asking... why say I want? #kids #speaking #toddlertalk
title_alts: 🤔 Teju learns the two words that start an asking sentence at breakfast #kids #speaking #toddlertalk
🤔 Teju keeps pointing at snacks... the asking mistake I want fixes #kids #speaking #toddlertalk
description_hook: Pointing only gets a guess. Two small words at the front turn it into a sentence anyone understands. Say I want with us, out loud.
protagonist_type: preschooler learning to speak in sentences

characters.name: Teju
characters.description: four years old, two short braids, yellow t-shirt, a red bead bracelet on her wrist

scenes.narration: Today we learn one sentence: I want. Teju points at the milk.
scenes.caption: आज हम एक वाक्य सीखेंगे: मुझे चाहिए। तेजू दूध की तरफ़ इशारा करती है।
scenes.image_brief: A tall glass of cold milk on a wooden kitchen table, an empty cereal bowl beside it, a small child's hand with a red bead bracelet stretched toward the glass, warm morning sunlight through the window, quiet and homely

scenes.narration: I want. Say it slowly: I want. Two small words, one big job.
scenes.caption: मुझे चाहिए। धीरे से कहो: मुझे चाहिए। दो छोटे शब्द, एक बड़ा काम।
scenes.image_brief: The same wooden kitchen table, the glass of milk in the middle, two paper cards leaning against the cereal bowl, one card showing the word I and the other showing the word want, soft morning light, tidy and bright

scenes.narration: Milk is in the glass. Teju says, I want the milk.
scenes.caption: गिलास में दूध है। तेजू कहती है, मुझे दूध चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: The glass of milk near the front of the wooden table, filled to the top with a few drops running down the outside, the two word cards I and want standing behind it, a folded yellow napkin alongside, warm morning light

scenes.narration: Your turn now. Put the thing after I want. Try it aloud.
scenes.caption: अब तुम्हारी बारी। चीज़ का नाम बाद में जोड़ो। ज़ोर से कहो।
scenes.image_brief: An empty child sized chair pulled out at the wooden kitchen table, the glass of milk waiting in front of it, the two word cards propped upright on the table, morning sunlight falling across the seat, welcoming and calm

scenes.narration: I want the milk, please! That whole sentence beats one pointing finger.
scenes.caption: मुझे दूध चाहिए, प्लीज़! पूरा वाक्य इशारे से बेहतर है।
scenes.image_brief: Two small hands, one wearing a red bead bracelet, lifting the glass of milk off the wooden kitchen table, a small milk bottle sticker stuck on the glass, warm morning light, bright and pleased

scenes.narration: Now toys. I want the blue truck. Now books: I want that story.
scenes.caption: अब खिलौने: मुझे नीला ट्रक चाहिए। अब किताबें: मुझे वह कहानी चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: A blue toy dump truck standing on a striped rug beside an open picture book, wooden blocks scattered around them, soft daylight from a nearby window, a bright and playful bedroom floor

scenes.narration: At bath time: I want the yellow duck, please.
scenes.caption: नहाने के समय: मुझे पीली बत्तख चाहिए, प्लीज़।
scenes.image_brief: A yellow rubber duck floating in a shallow bathtub with white foam around it, a folded towel on the tub edge, warm light through a frosted window, steamy and cheerful

scenes.narration: Which is the sentence? I want water, or just water? I want water.
scenes.caption: वाक्य कौन सा है? मुझे पानी चाहिए, या बस पानी? मुझे पानी चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: A glass of water in the middle of the wooden kitchen table with two white cards standing in front of it, the left card reading water and the right card reading I want water, soft daylight, clear and simple

scenes.narration: We learned I want: milk, truck, book, duck. I want the milk, please!
scenes.caption: हमने सीखा मुझे चाहिए: दूध, ट्रक, किताब, बत्तख। मुझे दूध चाहिए, प्लीज़!
scenes.image_brief: Four things in a row on the wooden kitchen table, the glass of milk, the blue toy truck, the closed picture book and the yellow rubber duck, warm evening light through the window, calm and satisfied

title: 🙌 Manav grabs the rolling ball... why does please work better? #kids #manners #speaking
title_alts: 🙌 Manav adds the word please to the end of every park request #kids #manners #speaking
🙌 Manav snatches at the park ball... the asking mistake please fixes #kids #manners #speaking
description_hook: One small word at the end of a sentence turns a grab into a request. Practise please with us at the park.
protagonist_type: preschooler learning to speak in sentences

characters.name: Manav
characters.description: five years old, short cropped hair, blue striped t-shirt, blue sandals

scenes.narration: Today we learn one small word: please. Manav wants the ball.
scenes.caption: आज हम एक छोटा शब्द सीखेंगे: प्लीज़। मानव को गेंद चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: A red rubber ball rolling across short green grass in a park, a metal slide and a low wire fence behind it, small blue sandals at the edge of the grass, bright late afternoon sun, lively and open

scenes.narration: Please. Say it again: please. It rides at the end of asking.
scenes.caption: प्लीज़। फिर कहो: प्लीज़। यह मांगने के आख़िर में आता है।
scenes.image_brief: The red rubber ball resting on park grass with a white card leaning against it, the word please printed large on the card, soft afternoon light, clear and calm

scenes.narration: The red ball rolls past. Manav asks: pass the ball, please.
scenes.caption: लाल गेंद पास से लुढ़कती है। मानव कहता है: गेंद दो, प्लीज़।
scenes.image_brief: The red rubber ball held between two small hands just above the park grass, the white please card lying on the grass nearby, warm afternoon light, friendly and bright

scenes.narration: Your turn. Name the thing, then add please at the end.
scenes.caption: अब तुम्हारी बारी। चीज़ का नाम लो, फिर आख़िर में प्लीज़ जोड़ो।
scenes.image_brief: An open patch of park grass with the red rubber ball in the middle and two small empty hands waiting on either side of it, the white please card upright behind the ball, golden afternoon light, inviting

scenes.narration: Pass the ball, please! One word turns grabbing into asking.
scenes.caption: गेंद दो, प्लीज़! एक शब्द छीनने को मांगना बना देता है।
scenes.image_brief: The red rubber ball in mid air above the park grass, passing between two pairs of small open hands, the white please card visible on the grass below, warm afternoon light, happy and easy

scenes.narration: At snack time: more rice, please. In the car: window down, please.
scenes.caption: खाने के समय: और चावल, प्लीज़। गाड़ी में: खिड़की नीचे, प्लीज़।
scenes.image_brief: A white bowl of steaming rice with a spoon resting in it on a kitchen table, beside it a toy car with its window rolled halfway down, warm daylight from a window, homely and cheerful

scenes.narration: Which one asks? Give me that, or give me that, please? Please wins.
scenes.caption: कौन सा मांगना है? वह दो, या वह दो, प्लीज़? प्लीज़ जीतता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two white cards standing upright on the park grass next to the red rubber ball, the left card reading give me that and the right card reading give me that please, soft afternoon light, calm and clear

scenes.narration: We learned please, with the ball, the rice, the window. Pass the ball, please!
scenes.caption: हमने प्लीज़ सीखा: गेंद, चावल, खिड़की। गेंद दो, प्लीज़!
scenes.image_brief: Three things lined up on the park grass, the red rubber ball, the white bowl of rice and the toy car with its window down, the white please card standing behind them, warm evening light, tidy and content

title: 🙋 Riya reaches across for the glue stick... why ask can I have? #kids #speaking #preschool
title_alts: 🙋 Riya learns the three words that ask for a turn politely #kids #speaking #preschool
🙋 Riya grabs instead of asking... the mistake can I have fixes #kids #speaking #preschool
description_hook: Three words turn a reach into a question, and a question gets an answer. Practise can I have at the craft table.
setting: a shared craft table in a playroom

characters.name: Riya
characters.description: five years old, curly shoulder length hair, green apron over a white t-shirt, a paper crown

scenes.narration: Today we learn three asking words: can I have. Riya needs glue.
scenes.caption: आज हम मांगने के तीन शब्द सीखेंगे: क्या मुझे मिल सकता है। रिया को गोंद चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: One purple glue stick standing upright in the middle of a low craft table, torn coloured paper and blunt scissors around it, a green apron hanging on the chair back, bright daylight from a tall window, busy and cheerful

scenes.narration: Can I have. Again: can I have. Three words ask.
scenes.caption: क्या मुझे मिल सकता है। फिर कहो: क्या मुझे मिल सकता है। तीन शब्द मांगते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: The purple glue stick lying on the craft table beside three white cards in a row, the cards reading can, I and have, scraps of coloured paper at the edges, bright daylight, clear and simple

scenes.narration: One glue stick sits on the craft table. Can I have it?
scenes.caption: गोंद की एक स्टिक मेज़ पर रखी है। क्या मुझे यह मिल सकती है?
scenes.image_brief: The purple glue stick with its cap off, standing on a sheet of paper on the craft table, a paper cut out star half stuck down next to it, warm daylight from the window, calm and inviting

scenes.narration: Now you ask. Say can I have, then the thing.
scenes.caption: अब तुम मांगो। कहो क्या मुझे मिल सकता है, फिर चीज़ का नाम।
scenes.image_brief: An empty chair at the craft table with the purple glue stick placed in front of it, two small open hands resting flat on the table top, paper shapes spread around, bright daylight, waiting and hopeful

scenes.narration: Can I have it, please? A question waits for an answer.
scenes.caption: क्या मुझे यह मिल सकता है, प्लीज़? सवाल जवाब का इंतज़ार करता है।
scenes.image_brief: The purple glue stick being handed from one small hand to another above the craft table, a finished paper star lying below, bright daylight from the window, warm and generous

scenes.narration: At the fruit bowl: can I have an orange, please?
scenes.caption: फलों की टोकरी पर: क्या मुझे एक संतरा मिल सकता है, प्लीज़?
scenes.image_brief: A wide ceramic bowl of fruit on a kitchen counter with three oranges, two bananas and a green apple in it, one orange sitting slightly forward on the counter, soft midday light, fresh and simple

scenes.narration: On the trike: can I have one turn, please?
scenes.caption: ट्राइसिकिल पर: क्या मुझे एक बारी मिल सकती है, प्लीज़?
scenes.image_brief: A red three wheeled trike parked on a paved courtyard with its handlebar streamers still, chalk drawings on the ground around it, late afternoon sunlight, quiet and expectant

scenes.narration: At the tap: can I have the cup, please?
scenes.caption: नल पर: क्या मुझे गिलास मिल सकता है, प्लीज़?
scenes.image_brief: A small blue plastic cup sitting on the edge of a low washbasin under a running tap, a drop of water on the rim, cool daylight from a high window, clean and quiet

scenes.narration: Which asks? Give me that, or can I have it? Can I have it.
scenes.caption: कौन सा मांगता है? वह दो, या क्या मुझे यह मिल सकता है? दूसरा सही है।
scenes.image_brief: Two white cards propped against the purple glue stick on the craft table, the left card reading give me that and the right card reading can I have it, bright daylight, clear and orderly

scenes.narration: We learned can I have: glue, orange, trike, cup. Can I have it, please?
scenes.caption: हमने सीखा: गोंद, संतरा, ट्राइसिकिल, गिलास। क्या मुझे यह मिल सकता है, प्लीज़?
scenes.image_brief: Four things arranged in a row on the craft table, the purple glue stick, one orange, a small red toy trike and the blue plastic cup, the three word cards behind them, warm late daylight, tidy and pleased

title: ✨ Aditi asks for bread and forgets the jam... which word joins both? #kids #speaking #grammar
title_alts: ✨ Aditi learns the word and, the one that joins two things #kids #speaking #grammar
✨ Aditi lists one thing at a time... the joining mistake and fixes #kids #speaking #grammar
description_hook: Two things, two trips, unless one little word does the work. Say and with us and hold both in a single sentence.
setting: a kitchen counter at lunch box time

characters.name: Aditi
characters.description: four years old, short bob with a clip, orange dungarees, one missing front tooth

scenes.narration: Today we learn one joining word: and. Aditi packs her lunch box.
scenes.caption: आज हम जोड़ने वाला एक शब्द सीखेंगे: और। अदिति अपना टिब्बिन पैक करती है।
scenes.image_brief: An open blue lunch box on a kitchen counter with two empty compartments, a slice of bread on a plate to the left and an open jar of red jam to the right, morning light from the window, homely and busy

scenes.narration: And. Say it again: and. One tiny word holds two things together.
scenes.caption: और। फिर कहो: और। एक छोटा शब्द दो चीज़ों को जोड़े रखता है।
scenes.image_brief: A single white card reading and, standing on the kitchen counter exactly between the slice of bread on its plate and the open jar of red jam, morning light, balanced and clear

scenes.narration: Bread is here. Jam is here. Aditi says bread and jam.
scenes.caption: ब्रेड यहाँ है। जैम यहाँ है। अदिति कहती है ब्रेड और जैम।
scenes.image_brief: A slice of soft bread on a white plate next to an open jar of red jam with a spoon in it on the kitchen counter, the and card between them, bright morning light, simple and appetising

scenes.narration: Your turn. Name one thing, say and, then name the second.
scenes.caption: अब तुम्हारी बारी। एक चीज़ का नाम लो, और कहो, फिर दूसरी का।
scenes.image_brief: The kitchen counter with the bread plate on one side, the jam jar on the other, and an empty gap in the middle where the and card usually stands, soft morning light, open and expectant

scenes.narration: Bread and jam, one sentence! Two things, one and between them.
scenes.caption: ब्रेड और जैम, एक वाक्य! दो चीज़ें, बीच में एक और।
scenes.image_brief: A finished jam sandwich cut in half sitting in the blue lunch box on the kitchen counter, the and card leaning against the box, the empty jam jar behind, warm morning light, satisfied and neat

scenes.narration: Getting dressed: socks and shoes. At the window: a cat and a dog.
scenes.caption: कपड़े पहनते समय: मोज़े और जूते। खिड़की पर: एक बिल्ली और एक कुत्ता।
scenes.image_brief: A pair of striped socks and a pair of small canvas shoes side by side on a doormat, and through the open door behind them a tabby cat and a brown dog sitting on a sunny step, soft daylight, friendly and everyday

scenes.narration: How many things does and hold? One or two? Two, always two.
scenes.caption: और कितनी चीज़ें जोड़ता है? एक या दो? दो, हमेशा दो।
scenes.image_brief: Two white cards on the kitchen counter showing the numbers one and two, with the and card standing between the bread plate and the jam jar behind them, bright morning light, clear and calm

scenes.narration: We learned and: bread and jam, socks and shoes, cat and dog. Bread and jam, one sentence!
scenes.caption: हमने सीखा: ब्रेड और जैम, मोज़े और जूते, बिल्ली और कुत्ता। एक वाक्य!
scenes.image_brief: Three pairs laid out along the kitchen counter, the bread with the jam jar, the socks with the shoes, and a small toy cat with a small toy dog, the and card standing at the front, warm midday light, tidy and complete

title: 😌 Parth tracks mud to the door... which word explains why? #kids #talking #preschool
title_alts: 😌 Parth learns the word because, the one that gives a reason #kids #talking #preschool
😌 Parth says what happened but not why... the mistake because fixes #kids #talking #preschool
description_hook: A sentence can carry the reason with it. One word does that job, and grown ups stop guessing. Say because with us.

characters.name: Parth
characters.description: five years old, straight fringe, red raincoat, yellow rubber boots

scenes.narration: Today we learn one why word: because. Parth stands in muddy boots.
scenes.caption: आज हम कारण बताने वाला एक शब्द सीखेंगे: क्योंकि। पार्थ कीचड़ भरे जूतों में खड़ा है।
scenes.image_brief: A pair of small yellow rubber boots caked with brown mud standing just inside a front door, wet footprints on the tiled floor behind them, rain dripping from the door frame, grey afternoon light, damp and quiet

scenes.narration: Because. Say it slowly: because. One word, and the reason follows.
scenes.caption: क्योंकि। धीरे से कहो: क्योंकि। एक शब्द, फिर कारण आता है।
scenes.image_brief: The muddy yellow boots on the tiled floor beside a white card reading because, a puddle of rainwater spreading from the boot soles, grey daylight from the open doorway, plain and clear

scenes.narration: The boots are muddy. Why? Because it rained all morning outside.
scenes.caption: जूते कीचड़ भरे हैं। क्यों? क्योंकि सुबह भर बारिश हुई।
scenes.image_brief: The muddy yellow boots on a doormat with heavy rain falling on the path outside the open door, brown water running along the path, grey afternoon light, wet and lively

scenes.narration: Your turn. Say what happened, then because, then the reason.
scenes.caption: अब तुम्हारी बारी। क्या हुआ बताओ, फिर क्योंकि, फिर कारण।
scenes.image_brief: The muddy yellow boots side by side on the doormat with the because card propped between them, a dry pair of slippers waiting on the floor nearby, soft grey light from the doorway, calm and ready

scenes.narration: Muddy boots, because it rained! Because answers the question why, every time.
scenes.caption: कीचड़ भरे जूते, क्योंकि बारिश हुई! क्योंकि हर बार क्यों का जवाब देता है।
scenes.image_brief: The muddy yellow boots being rinsed under a garden tap just outside the door, brown water running off onto the wet path, the because card resting safely on the step above, grey light after rain, fresh and pleased

scenes.narration: At the window: the plant grew because we watered it twice.
scenes.caption: खिड़की पर: पौधा बढ़ा क्योंकि हमने दो बार पानी दिया।
scenes.image_brief: A leafy green plant in a clay pot on a window sill with two new leaves at the top, a small watering can beside the pot, a damp ring of water on the sill, bright daylight through the glass, healthy and calm

scenes.narration: In the kitchen: the butter melted because the pan was warm.
scenes.caption: रसोई में: मक्खन पिघला क्योंकि कड़ाही गरम थी।
scenes.image_brief: A yellow pat of butter melting into a shiny pool in a warm frying pan on a stove, a wooden spatula resting in the pan, warm kitchen light, cosy and simple

scenes.narration: Which word gives the reason? And, or because? Because gives reasons.
scenes.caption: कारण कौन सा शब्द बताता है? और, या क्योंकि? क्योंकि कारण बताता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two white cards standing upright on the tiled floor beside the muddy yellow boots, the left card reading and and the right card reading because, grey daylight from the doorway, clear and simple

scenes.narration: We learned because: muddy boots, the plant, the butter. Muddy boots, because it rained!
scenes.caption: हमने क्योंकि सीखा: जूते, पौधा, मक्खन। कीचड़ भरे जूते, क्योंकि बारिश हुई!
scenes.image_brief: Three things arranged on the floor by the front door, the muddy yellow boots on the mat, the potted plant with its watering can, and the frying pan with melted butter, the because card standing in front, warm evening light, tidy and content

title: 😮 Suhani finds one shoe by the door... which word finds the other? #kids #speaking #questions
title_alts: 😮 Suhani learns the word where, the one that asks about places #kids #speaking #questions
😮 Suhani hunts in silence for her shoe... the mistake where fixes #kids #speaking #questions
description_hook: Hunting alone is slow. One question word brings every helper in the house to the search. Say where with us.
setting: a hallway by the front door

characters.name: Suhani
characters.description: four years old, high ponytail with a purple band, pink kurta, one red canvas shoe on

scenes.narration: Today we learn one asking word: where. Suhani has one shoe.
scenes.caption: आज हम सवाल वाला एक शब्द सीखेंगे: कहाँ। सुहानी के पास एक ही जूता है।
scenes.image_brief: One small red canvas shoe sitting alone on a wooden hallway floor beside a front door, an empty space next to it where the second shoe should be, a coat hook and a basket behind, soft morning light, quiet and puzzling

scenes.narration: Where. Say it again: where. It asks about a place.
scenes.caption: कहाँ। फिर कहो: कहाँ। यह जगह के बारे में पूछता है।
scenes.image_brief: The single red canvas shoe on the wooden hallway floor with a white card leaning against it, the word where printed large on the card, soft morning light from the doorway, plain and clear

scenes.narration: One red shoe waits by the door. Where is the other shoe?
scenes.caption: एक लाल जूता दरवाज़े के पास है। दूसरा जूता कहाँ है?
scenes.image_brief: The single red canvas shoe standing by the front door with its laces loose, a shoe basket tipped on its side nearby with slippers spilling out, soft morning light, everyday and untidy

scenes.narration: Now you ask. Say where is, then name the missing thing.
scenes.caption: अब तुम पूछो। कहो कहाँ है, फिर खोई चीज़ का नाम।
scenes.image_brief: The wooden hallway floor with the single red shoe and the where card side by side, two small empty hands held open above them, morning light falling across the boards, inviting

scenes.narration: Where is my other shoe? Someone hears and points under the bench.
scenes.caption: मेरा दूसरा जूता कहाँ है? कोई सुनता है और बेंच के नीचे इशारा करता है।
scenes.image_brief: The second red canvas shoe found under a low wooden bench in the hallway, its toe just visible in the shadow, the first shoe standing on the floor nearby, soft morning light, relieved and happy

scenes.narration: At dinner: where is my spoon? At bedtime: where is my bear?
scenes.caption: खाने पर: मेरा चम्मच कहाँ है? सोते समय: मेरा भालू कहाँ है?
scenes.image_brief: A dinner table with a steaming bowl of dal, a plate of rice and an empty place where a spoon should be, and through the doorway behind it a brown teddy bear sitting alone on a bedroom step, warm evening lamplight, homely and calm

scenes.narration: In the garden: where is the watering can?
scenes.caption: बगीचे में: पानी का डिब्बा कहाँ है?
scenes.image_brief: A small green garden with a row of young tomato plants and a bare patch of soil where a watering can usually stands, a coiled hose against the wall, bright morning light, fresh and open

scenes.narration: On the shelf: where is the small green cup?
scenes.caption: शेल्फ़ पर: छोटा हरा गिलास कहाँ है?
scenes.image_brief: A wooden kitchen shelf holding a blue cup, a white cup and a striped cup in a row, with a clear gap where a small green cup should stand, soft daylight from a window, tidy and simple

scenes.narration: Which word asks about a place? Who, or where? Where does.
scenes.caption: जगह के बारे में कौन पूछता है? कौन, या कहाँ? कहाँ पूछता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two white cards standing upright on the hallway floor next to the pair of red canvas shoes, the left card reading who and the right card reading where, soft morning light, clear and orderly

scenes.narration: We learned where: shoe, spoon, bear, can, cup. Where is my other shoe?
scenes.caption: हमने कहाँ सीखा: जूता, चम्मच, भालू, डिब्बा, गिलास। मेरा दूसरा जूता कहाँ है?
scenes.image_brief: Five things laid out in a row on the hallway floor, the pair of red canvas shoes, a metal spoon, the brown teddy bear, a green watering can and the small green cup, the where card standing in front, warm daylight, tidy and satisfied

title: 🎈 Zuri says I want juice. Why end sentences with please?
title_alts: 🗣️ The power of please in simple daily sentences
😌 Missing please makes requests sound rude and abrupt
description_hook: Learn how one magic word transforms a demand into a polite sentence.

characters.name: Zuri
characters.description: 5 years old, curly hair, blue t-shirt, red sneakers

scenes.narration: Today we learn how to ask nicely.
scenes.caption: आज हम सीखते हैं कि आदर से माँगना है।
scenes.image_brief: A bright, colorful playroom with soft daylight, a small table, and scattered toys emphasizing a safe, happy space.

scenes.narration: The word is please. Please. It sounds soft.
scenes.caption: शब्द है 'कृपया'। 'कृपया'। यह नरमी से लगता है।
scenes.image_brief: A large, friendly font displaying the word 'please' in a warm, glowing frame against a pastel background.

scenes.narration: Zuri wants a red balloon. She says please.
scenes.caption: ज़ूरी को लाल गुब्बारा चाहिए। वह कृपया कहती है।
scenes.image_brief: A red balloon floating gently next to a child's hand, with a clear view of the cheerful object and the gesture.

scenes.narration: Say it with me right now.
scenes.caption: मेरे साथ अभी कहो।
scenes.image_brief: A close-up of a microphone icon or sound wave graphic, inviting the viewer to speak aloud into their device.

scenes.narration: I want it, please!
scenes.caption: मुझे यह चाहिए, कृपया!
scenes.image_brief: A bright, encouraging visual of a smiling face made of simple geometric shapes, reinforcing the positive outcome of speaking politely.

scenes.narration: Green apple please. Blue car please.
scenes.caption: हरा सेब, कृपया। नीली कार, कृपया।
scenes.image_brief: Two distinct objects side-by-side: a vibrant green apple and a toy blue car, clearly separated for visual clarity.

scenes.narration: Yellow duck please. It works always.
scenes.caption: पीला बत्तखट, कृपया। यह हमेशा काम करता है।
scenes.image_brief: A rubber yellow duck sitting on a clean white surface, looking adorable and friendly, next to a star icon.

scenes.narration: Is this nice? I want it. Call it out.
scenes.caption: क्या यह अच्छा है? मुझे यह चाहिए। इसे बोलो।
scenes.image_brief: A split screen showing a stern face on the left and a smiling face on the right, prompting a choice.

scenes.narration: Balloon, apple, car, duck. I want it, please!
scenes.caption: गुब्बारा, सेब, कार, बत्तखट। मुझे यह चाहिए, कृपया!
scenes.image_brief: A collage of the previous objects—balloon, apple, car, duck—arranged in a row, ending with the text 'Please'.
